Embryo Explorer — human prenatal edition
Created by Pratik Gandhi with ChatGPT Astra.

Project inspiration: Virtual Embryo Challenge on Yukon, https://yukon.org/virtualembryo.
Challenge context: https://www.devo-evo.com/papers/virtual_embryo_challenge/.
Interaction inspiration: Ash (@ashebytes), https://x.com/ashebytes, and Human Atlas, https://github.com/ashemag/human-atlas.

Original procedural geometry, interface and choreography created for this project, available under the repository’s MIT license. No Human Atlas or eMouse Atlas assets are included.

Rendering: Three.js and OrbitControls, copyright 2010–2025 three.js authors, MIT license. See vendor/LICENSE.txt.
Demo soundtrack: Calm Ambient Science Medical Tech by Musinova, https://pixabay.com/music/corporate-calm-ambient-science-medical-tech-362424/. Used under the Pixabay Content License, https://pixabay.com/service/license-summary/. The music is excluded from the project’s MIT license and appears only within the edited demo video.

Scientific references: UNSW Embryology; National Museum of Health and Medicine Carnegie staging table; ACOG prenatal growth guidance; human intestinal development MRI research (PMID 26599074) and fetal cortical folding research (PMID 38979235). Full source links and interpretation limits: anatomy-matrix.md.
Scientific pages and papers were consulted as references. Their figures and meshes are not redistributed here.

This is an educational schematic illustration. It is not a clinical, diagnostic, predictive, or measured whole-body model and has not received specialist anatomical validation.
